Class AIChatModelProvider

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.ai.AIChatModelProvider
@Component public class AIChatModelProvider extends Object
Language models for user-defined fields. Each request tries the active providers of the caller's home tenant in priority order. Only rule proposals may fall back to the instance providers, and only with administrator consent. Value suggestions and key tests are always tenant-funded. Every attempt passes the budget gate and records its payer; technical failures move to the next provider, whereas a refused budget stops the chain. Clients are cached separately by key source, tenant, provider and model, and invalidated after credential changes. Endpoints come exclusively from the provider SDK or the deployment's Ollama configuration. Calls retain the 60 s timeout, no retries, and bounded output and reasoning tokens. Empty answers count as technical failures.

    • GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL

      public static final String GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL
      Google's alias of its newest Flash model. Google withdraws Gemini models from new users within months, faster than the model constants of Spring AI follow, so a fixed default answers 404 for a newly created key.

      Output tokens a reasoning model may spend before it answers. They count against the output limit and are billed as output; with no room for them gpt-5-mini used all 1000 tokens on reasoning and answered nothing.

    • call

      public AIChatModelProvider.AIChatResult call(org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, User user, AIRequestPurpose purpose)
      Sends one prompt, trying the providers in order of priority. Every attempt reserves a unit of the budgets before the call and records its outcome; a technical failure moves on to the next provider, and so does a tenant key that reached the daily limit its tenant set. When every key is at its tenant limit, the message says so.
      Parameters:
      prompt - the prompt
      user - the user on whose behalf the model is called
      purpose - what the call is for
      Returns:
      the answer and the provider that gave it
      Throws:
      DataViolationException - with a translated message when a budget refuses the request, no provider is configured, or every provider failed
      LimitEntityTransactionException - when the daily budget of the user is used up
